sources.title: Merck Manuals Shares What Patients Should Expect During a Neurologic Exam
sources.snippet: A neurologic exam can help identify and diagnose a wide range of disorders affecting the brain, spinal cord, or nerves. Many of these conditions are complex and difficult to diagnose. Yet a neurologic exam relies on simple exercises and basic medical tools to help clinicians establish a diagnosis.
